task.ques: Try the Word Scramble game in the Plus section, Can you beat the clock by unscrambling the letters to spell the word? (Just try the first example.)

claude.final_answer: FINAL: I opened Word Scramble in Cambridge Dictionary +Plus and tried to start the first example, but the game remained behind a security verification loop. No letters, answer, or score appeared, so I could not complete the example. The landing page says, “Can you beat the clock by unscrambling the letters to spell the word?” Evidence: final.png shows that Word Scramble page without overlays at https://dictionary.cambridge.org/plus/games/word-scramble (27 October 2026).
